object.name: Chi1 Orionis A
object.notes: Corrected CNS5 1464; exact source identity * chi01 Ori. Former system source snapshot, shared as an approximate component position and proper motion. No resolved orbital trajectory is claimed. The directly detected companion is stellar. Model age disagreements are retained as unknown individual ages. Reviewed membership and individual physical parameters: arXiv:astro-ph/0209404. Individually reviewed physical values/withholding: arXiv:astro-ph/0209404; supersedes blended-source values for these fields. Withheld individual fields: age_gyr, absolute_mag. radius_solar derived by Stefan-Boltzmann scaling from adopted inputs (solar Teff=5772 K); inherits their measurement/model/estimate assumptions. Reviewed component supplement: Component-specific published measurements supersede earlier withholding of aggregate measurements. No parent flux or unreviewed individual velocity is copied. Adopted fields: temperature_k: 2002A&A...394L..43K:4 (model-derived); metallicity_dex: 2002A&A...394L..43K:4 (measured); luminosity_solar: 2002A&A...394L..43K:4 (derived); radius_solar: Stefan-Boltzmann scaling (derived). Reviewed companion expansion of western-constellation-stars: Chi1 Orionis A; adopted nearest-1000:cns5-1464.
